key.flightsuit.suit_toggle: Suit (tap: call / board / step out, hold: all home)
tooltip.flightsuit.piece.chestplate: Arc reactor battery + palm repulsor (empty-hand right click).
tooltip.flightsuit.piece.leggings: Power assist: speed, step-up, softer landings.
tooltip.flightsuit.capsule.hint: Right click or G: suit up. Hold G: pack the worn suit away.
tooltip.flightsuit.energy_cell: Charges the worn suit by %s FE (or a capsule in the other hand).
message.flightsuit.no_suit: No stored suit found. Carry a filled suit capsule.
message.flightsuit.already_wearing: Take off the suit pieces you are wearing first (G packs them).
tooltip.flightsuit.edith: G: call the main suit · G while suited: step out (companion) · hold G: all suits home. Command HUD.
message.flightsuit.station_occupied: This station already holds a suit.
message.flightsuit.no_main_station: No main station. Right click a suit station to set one.
message.flightsuit.station_other_dimensi: Your main station is in another dimension.
message.flightsuit.station_empty: Your main station has no suit.
message.flightsuit.suit_stepped_out: Stepped out. The suit stays with you as a companion.
message.flightsuit.companion_no_power: Companion suit out of power. Board it or recover it.
message.flightsuit.companion_damaged: Companion suit damaged. Returning for repairs.
message.flightsuit.suit_needs_repair: Suit damaged - needs repair. Dock it at a station.
tooltip.flightsuit.cleaner_robot: Use on a cleaner dock to set it down. Right click robot: clean now · sneak: pick up. Sneak + empty-hand click the dock: draw an area · click with a stick: erase areas
tooltip.flightsuit.hover_car: Use on the ground to pop out the car. Ride: right click · Pack: sneak + empty hand · Charge: energy cell, or park near power blocks
message.flightsuit.cleaner_area_start: Drawing an area: right click the corner blocks, click the first corner again to close (sneak-click the dock to cancel)
message.flightsuit.cleaner_area_limit: A dock holds at most 8 areas.
message.flightsuit.cleaner_area_corner_c: Corner %s saved · click the first corner to close
message.flightsuit.cleaner_no_areas: No cleaning areas. Sneak + empty-hand click the dock to draw one.
message.flightsuit.cleaner_low_power: Dock power too low (2,000 FE per run).
message.flightsuit.cleaner_needs_dock: Use it on a cleaner robot dock.
message.flightsuit.cleaner_dock_taken: This dock already has a robot.
tooltip.flightsuit.class.stealth: Stealth: sneak in the full set to cloak · freeze beam instead of repulsor · 48-block helmet sensors
screen.flightsuit.wheel_hint: Click: deploy · Shift+click: swap in · Right click: set main · Center: all suits
message.flightsuit.wheel_needs_edith: The suit wheel needs EDITH glasses.
message.flightsuit.companion_already_out: That suit is already deployed. Shift+click to swap into it.
